examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The run as the home page places it: five solution areas, every picture at the closing end, each band linking to its solution page. Edit the props in the Controls panel — switch `kind` to `alternating`, or set a `title` to open the run with a header.

examples.name: Types
examples.summary: Both layouts stacked: the `media-end` run of solution areas with no header, then the `alternating` run of network claims under its centered header, the pictures swapping sides band by band.

site.name: Solutions
site.summary: The five solution areas of Home: large, centered bands, every picture at the closing end, each with an outlined "Learn more" button.

site.name: Alternating
site.summary: The Our Network run: a centered section title, then four bands alternating the picture between the opening and the closing end.
